audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Skill on rows 1, 2, first item and 2+ items while the content win[] and the packet levelChart read Karma, Karma, Lissandra, Lissandra.
audit.why: Mantra needs no skill point and is available at level 1, so Karma's empowered Inner Flame (950 range) beats your 725 Q before you have W. From first item onward you have a point-and-click 120s stun and she has single-target utility, so those rows are yours.
audit.corrected: Full sides realigned to Karma, Karma, Skill, Skill, Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra with each why rewritten to argue the verdict above it.

audit.why: Level 1 Mantra, level 6 Frozen Tomb, first-item CDR and late teamfighting are all captured in the four content spikes.
audit.corrected: Left as-is; phases[5] and phases[6] whys now name the Mantra cooldown that creates your window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tether-break rule, Mantra's cooldown, and the fact that Mantra-W heals Karma were all absent from the fields that decide play.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s at every rank at 675 range and only roots if the tether survives; Mantra is 40/38/36/34s and her damaging abilities lower it; the Mantra bonus on W heals her, which is the anti-heal flag the missing-interactions file raises. Frozen Tomb self-cast is untargetable and invulnerable, which is the clean answer to a committed Mantra-Q.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries the real numbers and the tether-break rule; breakdown.early carries the anti-heal timing; dosFull[1].d explains the self-tomb answer instead of repeating tradeGood.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance anywhere despite Mantra-W healing her through extended trades.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags Focused Resolve as her sustain.

edits.before: Late Liss opens every fight: claw in, tomb the carry, root the peel, and walk out through the panic.

edits.before: Turn his kill windows into tomb refunds, then out-pick him in every river. Focused Resolve (Tether) is the clock this lane runs on — read it before every step forward.
edits.after: Turn her poke windows into tomb refunds, then out-pick her in every river. Focused Resolve (Tether) is the clock this lane runs on — 12s flat at every rank, 675 range.

edits.before: Karma wins by landing Focused Resolve (Tether), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Karma wins by tethering you at 675, holding the root while Inner Flame lands from 950, then shielding away the answer you finally get to throw.

edits.after: Q-shatter her wave contact, and when she steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk out of the 675 tether — a broken Focused Resolve never roots.

edits.before: - Lissandra vs Karma - Track: Karma Focused Resolve (Tether). - Hold W for his gap-close — the root IS the matchup. - Fights start when Focused Resolve (Tether) ends. - The R is for endings, not openings.
edits.after: - Lissandra vs Karma - Track: Karma Focused Resolve (Tether), 12s at every rank. - Hold W for her step-up — the root IS the matchup. - Fights start when Focused Resolve (Tether) ends. - The R is for endings, not openings.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Check it before every step-up. - R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve: 12s at every rank, 675 range — break the tether and the second hit never roots. - Inner Flame: 9s down to 5s, thrown from 950. - Mantra: 40/38/36/34s, and her damage ticks it down, so count her casts. - Your R is 120s at rank 1.

edits.after: Q-farm and pick your moments — Mantra-W heals her through chip, so buy anti-heal before extended trades. Reach 6 with claw and tomb intact.
